description: Per-workspace agent approval policy, read from <workspace>/.cursor/permissions.json. Mirrors Cursor's extensions/cursor-always-local/schemas/permissions.schema.json: properties mcpAllowlist / terminalAllowlist / approvalMode / autoRun / autoReview. approvalMode=manual means Ask Every Time.

approvalMode.description: Master approval switch. allowlist: auto-approve allowlisted entries, ask for the rest. unrestricted: approve everything without asking. manual: Ask Every Time — ask for every tool call.

autoReview.description: Reserved: parsed and validated; exact Cursor semantics UNKNOWN (see permissionsFileService.ts).

autoRun.description: Reserved: parsed and validated; exact Cursor semantics UNKNOWN (see permissionsFileService.ts).

mcpAllowlist.description: MCP tools the agent may call without asking, as "server:tool" or "server:*" patterns (e.g. "github:create_pr", "filesystem:*").

terminalAllowlist.description: Shell commands the agent may run without asking, as glob patterns matched against the command text (e.g. "git status", "npm run *"). "*" matches any sequence of characters.

title: Agent permissions (.cursor/permissions.json)
